title: Page 10
content_zh:
普宁呢，则是一路保持极高的玩兴。她坐在马上的姿势，除了新婚当夜之外，一律侧坐。这是于季友的体贴，他怕她娇嫩的身子禁不起颠簸，会把她给弄伤了。
但没想到，这坐姿竟让她想出好几个玩弄他的点子－－不是啃他颈脖，就是偷偷钻进他斗篷，隔着衣物抚弄他。
好在时间日久，路上旅人越少，他越不必担心被人撞见。常常于季友被得兴起，便一拉马鞭，抱着娇妻到丛里好好“整治”一番。
这回，普宁又故技重施。两人骑马走了半天，她开始觉得无聊，眼一睨，就回头把玩起自个儿夫婿解闷。从外瞧，身裹着斗篷的于季友看似衣裳整齐，可里边，早已被一双嫩手脱得衣衫不整。
“够了，苹儿。”他声音微喘。平常他不会阻止，可这会儿前头出现一列车队，他怕走近些，会被人发现他脸上可疑的红晕。
她从他斗篷钻出，一瞧前头，懂了。
但以为她会就此收手？！才不！
她只是稍微理理自己微乱的云鬓，好教外人看了不致怀疑，然后手呢，没一会儿又钻进他斗篷中。
于季友眉一皱，嘴里喃喃斥：“你这家伙……”
“不喜欢我这么碰你？”她着纯真的大眼睛瞅他，可手上的动作，却邪恶至极。
“够了。”他下颚抵着她发出shen|吟，感觉她再多抚弄一会儿，他就会在她掌间爆发了。
“不够。”她状似依偎地靠上他胸口，可藏在斗篷里的右手，却偷偷捻着他右胸，享受那平滑的ru|首渐渐如扣绊般突起的触感。“每天晚上人家都被你弄得欲仙欲死，人家现在也要让你尝尝那滋味。”
他嘴贴在她额畔提醒道：“你不怕到了晚上，我又如法炮制？”
“来啊。”她妩媚眨眼。“反正我现在不做，晚一点你还不是会做……”
他发出沙哑的笑声。果真冰雪聪明，这么快就摸熟他的习性。
“我没办法不碰你……”说完这句，他眼一眺前方的车队，突然一拉马缰，让白骄转了个方向。
一待四下无人，他立刻俯头吻住她嘴。
“你这折磨人的小妖精……”
等两人再回马上，普宁再也挤不出力气淘气，只能脸贴在他胸口，疲累睡去。
当晚，两人留宿关口。此地正是城甸与大漠的交界，于季友打算在此逗留几日，待普宁养足精神，也备足饮水吃食，再雇骆驼出关。

休息的时候，他也捎了封信回家，禀告爹娘一路平安，待赏过大漠风光，他定会带着娇妻速速归乡。
一早，天刚露鱼肚白，于季友和普宁已跟在出关的队伍中。
于季友的白驹留在骆驼贩处，说好两天，他会带着雇来的骆驼回去交换。
一出关门，普宁立刻瞠大眼。他先前提过的山川景色如实映入眼帘，一畦畦的麦田，葡萄田，绵亘不绝的甜杏树与香瓜藤。两人各别骑着骆驼停在小贩摊前，于季友买了几串葡萄跟甜杏，好让普宁无聊时可以剥着吃。
远远，有片碧绿草原，上头立着数也数不清的牛羊，还有些圆顶的皮屋子。普宁一路惊奇，这些画面，她往常只在画里瞧见。
但一跨过草原，四周的青绿色渐渐少了。他给了她一壶水，一边解释说：“再过去就是少漠，我不打算走远，再一个时辰我们就停脚休息。”
“沙漠有多大？”她辽开遮荫的面纱眺望。
“不下千里。”他说道：“前几年突厥来侮，我跟阿爹领皇命出兵对抗，那时曾追赶敌兵到沙漠深处，我当时以为已到了地之尽头，可一问同行官兵，才知不过走了一半。”
她眨眨眼。“突厥人住这么偏远？”
他点头。“所以性格剽悍异常。”
说来虏族也是沙漠之子，只是于氏一脉汉化较早，性格不若突厥人粗野。
不到中午，两人进入沙漠地带。他找了个背风处落脚，挖了个沙坑，用拾来的枯柴干枝烧了点水。
两人分食先前买来的葡萄跟干粮，吃饱之后，他要她先小睡片刻，以免晚些瘕累，错过了好戏。
这就是他心心念念的美景。
“好漂亮。”她发出叹息。
入夜前，有个短暂的奇幻时光，整片蓝天染上夕阳的橘光，眨个眼变成紫色，接着星星亮起，一弯明月，近得像手一伸就能摸到。
两人蜷在并起的斗篷里边，月华如水，映得黄土岗子一片银灿。她朝夜空伸出手，发现竟没法子看见自个儿指尖。
黝静的黑夜，隐约可听见骆驼的喷气声，感觉大地，只剩下他与她两个人。
“我有点怕。”
“有我在。这地方我熟，不会有贼人来袭。”他侧身环住她。

她瞠大眼睛看他。“你一个少主，为什么对这地方这么熟？”
“我一年总会来个几回。”他眼力好，即使在深夜，也能看见极远的地方。“应该说是血脉的呼唤，偶尔在城里住得心闷，我会骑马跑来这儿住上几夜，也没做什么，就像我们这样躺着看看星星月亮，烦闷就会自己消解了。”
“难怪你先前会说自己是野马。”
他一笑，白牙在夜里幽暗发光。“但我倒看错了你，你不只是娇贵的牡丹。”
“不……”她头偎在他肩上，四周寂静，即使耳语，听起来也无比清晰。“在没遇上你之前，我的确是牡丹。我从不知道自己能吃苦，也没那个环境让我吃苦，但接连几日伴着你东奔西跑，我发现，说不定我骨子里，也是匹野马。”
“是啊，而且还是匹色母马。”他附和。
讨厌，取笑她。她眸儿一瞪。“还不是你教的！”
他故作讶异地挑眉。“是么？我怎么不记得我教过你，要在马上对我上下其手？”
“哼。”她捶他。
他低笑掳住她手，然后身子一翻，又将她紧压在沙地上。
“你真美，我的小苹儿……”他以鼻挲蹭她，然后咬开她领上的悬钮，隔着里衣舔上她突挺的胸脯。
她手滑勾住他膀，在他逗弄完一边移至另一边时，弓起背脊配合。
当夜，两人共享一个极其甜美的夜晚。照例，普宁又在欢爱之后沈沉睡去，可是过不了多久，她又被他接连的吻唤醒。
“该醒了……”
“还困。”
她揉着双眼嘟嚷，可当定神一见戈色，忍不住发出惊呼。
东方朝阳刚吐，将满地沙岗映得有如黄金般耀眼。她手揪着斗篷站起，感觉自己像置身在一个玄幻的国度里。
“我就想让你瞧瞧这个。”他同披着斗篷低喃。
她望向他，突然间明白他带她来的原因。
这一路风景，高山野地，城岗小镇，乃至这片沙漠，都是他宽广心廓的象征。他有奔放爽飒如大漠旷野的壮志豪情，也有蜿蜒曲折如流水般涓流的细腻。他要她看清楚这一切，这就是将来要与她携手共度一生的男人。

她好开心，又觉得荣幸，能在茫茫人海中，嫁给一个令她心折心动的夫君。
她倚身向他，娇柔地蹭着他胸口。“我们会一直在一起，对不对？”
“当然。”他笑着牵起她手，在天与地的见证之下，吻了他最心爱的女人。
天上一卷一卷的云丝，就害羞似的，轻巧巧地飘过天际。
两颗悸动不已的心，在此合而为一。
【全文完】
后记　艾珈
好高兴又能在这里跟大家说话。
早先我开【天下一品】系列时，刚写出《龙大当家》，就一直很想跳出来跟大家说点什么，关于我为何如此设定安排角色的原由。但我又怕我这么一说，会坏了大家的读兴－－哪有人书还没出话就讲在前头？只好忍啊忍、忍啊忍，忍到了《千金小厨娘》写完，发觉这系列好像还缺了什么，所以特别央求编辑，让我再补一个番外篇。

Puning, on the other hand, maintained a high level of fun all the way. She always sits on her side when sitting on a horse, except on her wedding night. This was Yu Jiyou's consideration. He was afraid that her delicate body could not withstand the bumps and would injure her.
But she didn't expect that this sitting position actually made her come up with several ideas to play with him - either nibbling on his neck, or sneaking into his cloak and caressing him through his clothes.
Fortunately, as time went by, there were fewer travelers on the road, and he didn't have to worry about being bumped into. Often when Ji You was aroused, he would pull his horsewhip and take his beloved wife to the bush for a good "rectification".
This time, Puning repeated his old tricks. The two of them rode for a long time, and she began to feel bored. As soon as she glanced at him, she turned back to play with her husband to relieve her boredom. From the outside, Yu Jiyou, who was wrapped in a cloak, seemed to be neatly dressed, but inside, his clothes had already been stripped off by a pair of young hands.
"That's enough, Ping'er." His voice was slightly breathy. Normally he wouldn't stop it, but now a motorcade appeared in front of him, and he was afraid that if he got closer, someone would notice the suspicious blush on his face.
She got out of his cloak, looked ahead, and understood.
But do you think she will stop there? ! No!
She just straightened her messy hair a little, so that outsiders wouldn't be suspicious, and then her hands got into his cloak again after a while.
Yu Jiyou frowned and muttered: "You guy..."
"Don't you like me touching you like this?" She looked at him with big innocent eyes, but the movements of her hands were extremely evil.
"That's enough." He groaned as he pressed his chin against hers, feeling that if she caressed him for a little longer, he would explode in her palm.
"Not enough." She seemed to be snuggling up to his chest, but her right hand hidden in the cloak was secretly twirling his right chest, enjoying the touch of the smooth breast that gradually protruded like a clasp. "Every night you make me so horny that I want you to have a taste of it now."
He put his mouth against her forehead and reminded: "Aren't you afraid that at night, I will do the same thing again?"
"Come on." She winked charmingly. "Anyway, if I don't do it now, you won't be able to do it later..."
He let out a raucous laugh. Sure enough, Bingxue was really smart, and she got to know his habits so quickly.
"I can't help but touch you..." After saying this, he looked at the motorcade in front of him and suddenly pulled the reins of the horse, causing Bai Jiao to turn in another direction.
As soon as no one was around, he immediately bent down and kissed her mouth.
"You tortured little goblin..."
When the two of them got back on their horses, Puning could no longer muster the energy to be naughty, so she could only press her face against his chest and fall asleep from exhaustion.
That night, the two stayed overnight at Guankou. This place is the junction between Chengdian and the desert. Yu Jiyou plans to stay here for a few days. After Puning has regained his energy and prepared enough water and food, he will hire camels to leave the customs.
While resting, he also sent a letter home, telling his parents that the journey was safe and that he would return home quickly with his beloved wife after enjoying the scenery of the desert.
Early in the morning, when the sky was just turning white, Yu Jiyou and Puning were already following the team leaving the customs.
Yu Jiyou's white horse was left at the camel dealer's place, and he agreed that he would return with the hired camel in two days for exchange.
As soon as the door closed, Puning's eyes widened immediately. The mountain scenery he mentioned before came into view, including a row of wheat fields, grape fields, and endless sweet apricot trees and cantaloupe vines. The two of them rode camels and stopped in front of the hawker stall. Yu Jiyou bought a few bunches of grapes and sweet apricots so that Puning could peel and eat them when he was bored.
In the distance, there is a green grassland with countless cattle and sheep standing on it, as well as some domed leather houses. Puning was amazed all the way. She had only seen these scenes in paintings before.
But once we crossed the grassland, the surrounding green gradually became less and less. He gave her a pot of water and explained: "The next step is Shaomo. I don't plan to go far. We will stop and rest in an hour."
"How big is the desert?" She opened her shading veil and looked out.
"No less than a thousand miles away," he said.A few years ago, when the Turks invaded, my father and I led the emperor's orders to send troops to fight. At that time, we chased the enemy soldiers into the depths of the desert. I thought we had reached the end of the earth, but when I asked the officers and soldiers accompanying me, I realized that we were only halfway there. "
She blinked. “Do Turks live in such remote areas? "
He nodded. “So he has an extremely fierce personality. "
It can be said that the Lu people are also the sons of the desert, but the Yu family became Chinese earlier and their character is not as rough as the Turks.
Before noon, the two entered the desert area. He found a place to stay in the lee of the wind, dug a sand pit, and boiled some water with dry firewood and branches he had picked up.
The two shared the grapes and dry food they bought earlier. After eating, he asked her to take a nap first so as not to be tired later and miss the good show.
This is the beauty that he longs for.
"So beautiful. "She sighed.
Before night falls, there is a brief magical time. The entire blue sky is dyed with the orange light of the sunset, and turns purple in the blink of an eye. Then the stars light up, and a bright moon is so close that you can touch it with your hand.
The two of them were curled up in their folded cloaks, and the moonlight was like water, reflecting the silvery color of the loess hills. She stretched out her hand toward the night sky and found that she couldn't see her fingertips.
In the quiet dark night, the snorting sound of camels could be vaguely heard, and it felt like he and she were the only two people left on the earth.
"I'm a little scared. "
"I'm here. I know this place well, no thieves will attack. ” He put his arms around her sideways.
She looked at him with wide eyes. "You are a young master, why are you so familiar with this place? "
“I always come here a few times a year. "He has good eyesight and can see very far away places even in the middle of the night. "It should be said that it is the call of the blood. Sometimes I feel depressed when living in the city. I will ride here and stay here for a few nights without doing anything. Just lie down and look at the stars and the moon like this, and the boredom will disappear by itself. "
"No wonder you said you were a wild horse before. "
When he smiled, his white teeth glowed dimly in the night. "But I was wrong about you, you are not just a delicate peony. "
"No..." She rested her head on his shoulder, and there was silence all around. Even if she whispered, it sounded extremely clear. "Before I met you, I was indeed Peony. I never knew that I could endure hardship, nor was I in an environment that allowed me to endure hardship. But after running around with you for several days, I discovered that maybe I am also a wild horse at heart. "
“Yes, and it’s a lusty mare. ” he echoed.
Annoying, making fun of her. She stared. "You didn't teach me! "
He raised his eyebrows in mock surprise. "Really? Why don't I remember that I taught you to touch me on a horse? "
"snort. "She hit him.
He chuckled and grabbed her hand, then turned over and pressed her tightly against the sand.
"You are so beautiful, my little Ping'er..." He nuzzled her, then bit open the button on her collar and licked her protruding breasts through her underwear.
She slid her hands around his shoulders and arched her back to cooperate when he moved from one side to the other after teasing.
That night, the two shared an extremely sweet night. As usual, Puning fell asleep again after making love, but not long after, she was awakened by his successive kisses.
"It's time to wake up..."
“Still sleepy. "
She rubbed her eyes and muttered, but when she regained her composure and saw Ge's color, she couldn't help but exclaim.
The sun rises from the east, reflecting the sandy hills all over the ground as dazzling as gold. She stood up holding her cloak in her hands, feeling like she was in a fantasy country.
"I just want you to see this. "He murmured while wearing a cloak.
She looked at him and suddenly understood why he had brought her here.
The scenery along the way, the mountains and wilderness, the small towns, and even this desert are all symbols of his broad mind. He has the ambition and pride that is unrestrained and refreshing, like a desert wilderness, and he also has the delicacy that twists and turns like flowing water. He wanted her to see all this clearly, this was the man she would spend her life with in the future.
She was so happy and felt honored to be able to marry someone who made her heart beat in a huge crowd.Moving husband.
She leaned towards him and rubbed his chest tenderly. "We'll always be together, right?"
"Of course." He smiled and took her hand, and under the witness of heaven and earth, he kissed his most beloved woman.
Rolls of clouds in the sky float across the sky lightly and shyly.
Two throbbing hearts become one here.
[End of full text]
Postscript Aijia
I'm so happy to be here again talking to you all.
Earlier when I started the [Tianxiapin] series, I had just written "The Master of the Dragon", and I always wanted to jump out and tell you something about why I set up and arranged the characters the way I did. But I'm afraid that if I say this, it will ruin everyone's interest in reading - how can anyone talk about it before the book is even published? I had to endure and endure, endure and endure. After finishing "The Little Chef", I realized that this series seemed to be missing something, so I begged the editor to let me add another extra chapter.
